description: Extract data from invoices, receipts, purchase orders, bank statements, passports and any other document with Nanonets: send a PDF, image or spreadsheet to a workflow and get each field's value, every value found with its confidence, and tables such as line items as rows. Review documents (approve, assign, and correct values and tables), manage workflows and the fields they extract, classify images, and query the databases connected to Nanonets. Needs a Nanonets account.
